title: render() always throws: save and report are never defined or imported
evidence: app.js has no import and no declaration of save or report (grep over the workspace finds them only at app.js:5 and app.js:6). In an ES module (it uses export) a call to an undeclared identifier throws ReferenceError. Line 6 therefore throws on every call; the catch then calls report(e), which throws a second ReferenceError from inside the catch block. Nothing catches it.
failing_case: Call render(el, 'x') with localStorage.getItem('cart') returning null or valid JSON. el.textContent is set, JSON.parse succeeds, save(data) throws ReferenceError: save is not defined, the catch calls report(e) and throws ReferenceError: report is not defined. render never reaches 'return data', so every caller gets an exception instead of the cart. Corrupt JSON in localStorage ('{bad') also hits line 5's catch, which throws the same ReferenceError, so the error handling meant to survive bad data is itself the crash.
remediation: Import or define save and report (report must not throw and should show the user a cause and next step). Add a test that calls render with valid, null and corrupt stored data and checks that it returns without throwing and reports the failure.
